licence      : public domain

Build flags live in native/SConstruct. sqlite3.c is compiled as C, unlike Lua, which
ocgcore forces through a C++ compiler (AGENTS.md section 8.1). SQLite has no such
requirement: it never unwinds through our frames because CardDB closes the handle before
any duel exists.

To upgrade: download a newer amalgamation from https://sqlite.org/download.html, verify the
published SHA3-256, replace the two files and update this file. Nothing else in the repo
depends on the SQLite version.
